Application log with Hibernate DDL, SQL, bind trace and exceptions (keys/JWT/bcrypt redacted)

results.rationale: originalName is length-checked nowhere in the application. 256 chars persists (upload and TEXT transfer); 257 chars reaches INSERT into files / transferring_files and H2 rejects with SQLState 22001 'Value too long for column ORIGINAL_NAME CHARACTER VARYING(256)'.
